integrity: All quantified formulas are proved algebraically. The bundled exact-rational replay is a finite consistency check, not an infinite proof. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-proximal, one-dimensional strongly convex quadratic specialization. The unbounded transient factor ranges over admissible positive summable expansion sequences and does not claim that practical parameter choices necessarily spike.
title: Exact spike-and-reset law for NIPG on scalar strongly convex quadratics
